sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Know Your Enemy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Finally some good fucking news! Those assholes showed up on a couple of cameras in the city. Whole squad dressed in black, gear's definitely not Russian, but it doesn't look like USEC equipment either. That means someone got them across the border, and they sure as hell didn't come here with friendly intentions. We need to push back before they cut off all our routes. Can you bring me some of their gear? I've got a buddy who knows his way around this kind of stuff. Maybe he'll be able to tell us who we're about to go to war with. I'll need their body armor or rigs."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over 5 any Black Division plate carriers

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,000 EXP
- 180,000 Roubles
  - 189,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 207,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 5× F-1 hand grenade
- 5× RGD-5 hand grenade
"Excellent work. I don't think anyone but you could've taken down fighters like that right now. The sooner we find out where they train soldiers like these, and what bastard decided to send them into Tarkov, the better... Whoever's behind this has plenty of resources and even bigger ambitions."
